parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the request—scheduling weekly exports directly to your S3 bucket instead of downloading CSVs manually would definitely save time.

To help our team assess what’s possible and what we’d need to configure, could you share a few details?
1) Which export(s) you’re using today (which product/workspace/dataset(s))?
2) Do you want an ongoing weekly schedule, and what day/time + timezone should it run?
3) In S3, what would you prefer for file structure/naming (e.g., one file per run, include timestamp, folder/prefix)?
4) How should the export authenticate to your S3 bucket (e.g., an IAM role/policy or credentials/connection method your team prefers)?
5) Should each run overwrite prior files, append new ones, or keep historical outputs (and any retention preference)?

Once we have this, we can route it to the right team for evaluation and follow up with the next steps. You mentioned it isn’t blocking—thank you—and we’ll aim to get clarity on feasibility and options as quickly as we can.
